lines.en: label soccer10:
scene soccerfield
I make my way onto the soccer field in a slightly better mood than normal- probably on account of how many thighs I am going to see today.
lines.zh: 我踏上足球场，心情比平时略好一点——大概是因为今天能看到的大腿不少。

lines.en: Perhaps it's a little more than that, though?
lines.zh: 不过，也许还不止于此？

lines.en: Perhaps I actually {i}enjoy{/i} spending time with Miku and...trying to keep up with her bullet-train of thought or something?
lines.zh: 也许我真的{i}享受{/i}和 Miku 待在一起……试着跟上她那子弹列车般的思路什么的？

lines.en: Hell, at this rate, I might actually wind up becoming the coach of this team.
lines.zh: 见鬼，照这个势头下去，我说不定真会变成这支队伍的教练。

lines.en: That is, assuming it doesn't hurl a wrench at my {i}extremely busy{/i} schedule as the world's worst teacher.
lines.zh: 前提是这不会朝我这个全世界最差老师{i}极其忙碌{/i}的日程扔来一扳手。

lines.en: Does that analogy still work when the wrench is being thrown {i}at{/i} something rather than inserted {i}into{/i} something? I don't know.
lines.zh: 当扳手是被扔{i}向{/i}什么东西、而不是被塞{i}进{/i}什么东西里的时候，这个比喻还成立吗？我不知道。

lines.en: Besides, how busy can coaching a girls’ soccer team possibly be when they don’t even play any games?
lines.zh: 再说了，一支连比赛都不打的女子足球队，当教练能有多忙？

lines.en: : Senseiiiiii!!!!!
I’m suddenly assaulted as Miku crashes into my back at full speed.
lines.zh: Miku 全速撞上我的后背，我猝不及防地遭到袭击。

lines.en: She does her best to wrap her arms around my abdomen in an alarmingly friendly greeting hug, but doesn’t find much success as her hands can barely touch one another.
lines.zh: 她使出浑身解数想把双臂环上我的腰，来一个热情得吓人的招呼式拥抱，可惜收效甚微——她的两只手几乎碰不到一块儿。

lines.en: : Woah! Your abs are super hard, Sensei. I knew you were muscley, but this makes it seem like you're some kinda bodybuilder or somethin'.
lines.zh: : 哇哦！老师的腹肌超硬的。我知道你一身肌肉，可这也硬得像个健美选手似的。

lines.en: : Nope. Not even close. The only exercise I ever really get is just...walking around town.
lines.zh: : 不。差得远。我真正做的唯一运动就是……在镇上走走。

lines.en: scene nightvisionredux1
Miku releases her death grip on my suspiciously hard abdomen, allowing me to turn around and actually face who I'm speaking to.
lines.zh: Miku 松开对我那硬得可疑的腹肌的死亡缠绕，我这才得以转过身，看清自己在跟谁说话。

lines.en: : You know, if ya ever wanna get some more exercise, I’m always around!
lines.zh: : 我说，你要是哪天想多锻炼锻炼，我随时都在哦！

lines.en: : Maybe I could be your personal trainer or somethin'? First three lessons are free.
lines.zh: : 要不我当你的私人教练啥的？头三节课免费。

lines.en: : {i}I{/i} would need to be paid in order to convince me to run with you, Miku. That is not a thing I...ever want to do.
lines.zh: : 得有人付{i}我{/i}钱，才能说服我陪你跑步，Miku。那是我……这辈子都不想做的事。

lines.en: : At least not until you learn to calm down a bit.
lines.zh: : 至少得等你学会稍微安分一点再说。

lines.en: scene nightvisionredux2
: Oh, come on! You think I’m some kinda slave-driver or somethin'?
lines.zh: : 哎呀，别这样！你觉得我是那种逼死人的监工吗？

lines.en: : I’m totally fine with just joggin' if your stamina ain't all that great. That's what I have to do with Makoto whenever I can convince her to come with me.
lines.zh: : 你要是体力不太行，我慢慢跑也完全没问题。我每次好不容易把 Makoto 拉出来，就是这么干的。

lines.en: : Heck, I could even give ya a piggyback ride if you get tired!
lines.zh: : 见鬼，你要是累了，我还能背你走呢！

lines.en: : I would literally crush you.
lines.zh: : 我会把你压扁的，字面意义上的。

lines.en: scene nightvisionredux3
: Nuh-uh! I could totally lift you up!
lines.zh: : 才不会！我绝对能把你举起来！

lines.en: : Please don't try.
lines.zh: : 请别试。

lines.en: : Well, I kinda have to now.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这下我非试不可了。

lines.en: : You really don't.
lines.zh: : 你真不用。

lines.en: scene nightvisionredux4
: Prepare for liftoff, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 准备起飞吧，老师！

lines.en: Miku once again takes position behind me and wraps her arms around my body. Or at least...tries to.
lines.zh: Miku 再次绕到我身后，双臂环住我的身体。或者说……试图环住。

lines.en: She arches her back and bends her knees, attempting to lift me up, but obviously failing due to the fact that I’m more than double her weight.
lines.zh: 她弓起背、屈下膝，试图把我举起来，但显然失败了——毕竟我的体重是她的两倍还多。

lines.en: : Guh...What the heck is this? How are you this heavy? I can lift up Kirin just fine.
lines.zh: : 呃……这什么情况？你怎么这么重？我抬 Kirin 轻轻松松的。

lines.en: : I have no idea who Kirin is, but I am going to guess she is not a six foot male with suspiciously hard abs.
lines.zh: : 我不知道 Kirin 是谁，但我猜她应该不是个六英尺高、腹肌硬得可疑的男人。

lines.en: scene nightvisionredux5
: Maybe I should practice on her sister before I try pickin' you up again?
lines.zh: : 那我要不再拿她妹妹练练手，然后再来抬你？

lines.en: : Maybe. Or, here's an even better idea, you could just...give up.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。或者，我有个更好的主意，你就……放弃吧。

lines.en: : Whatever. I know when to accept defeat.
lines.zh: : 随便啦。我知道什么时候该认输。

lines.en: scene nightvisionredux1
: But yeah! If ya ever wanna run around or anything like that, I promise I won’t blow ya out of the water!
lines.zh: : 不过说真的！你要是想跑跑步啥的，我保证不会把你虐得太惨！

lines.en: : Or if you just wanna come grab a snack with me and Makoto, that’s okay too!
lines.zh: : 或者你只想跟我和 Makoto 去吃点零食，也行呀！

lines.en: : Did Makoto pay you to say this?
lines.zh: : 这是 Makoto 花钱让你说的？

lines.en: scene nightvisionredux2
: Hahaha! Not this time, I promise! This invitation is 100%% Miku-approved!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈！这次真没有，我保证！这次邀请可是 100%% Miku 亲口批准的！

lines.en: scene nightvisionredux1
: It's only a matter of time 'til you become our coach, so we should probably start gettin’ to know each other better anyway, right?
lines.zh: : 你当我们的教练只是时间问题，所以我们干脆趁现在多熟悉熟悉，对吧？

lines.en: : You sound pretty confident that this is a thing I’m going to eventually do.
lines.zh: : 你听起来挺有把握，觉得我迟早会干这事的。

lines.en: : I am confident! Why else would ya keep showin’ up here?
lines.zh: : 我就是有把握！不然你干嘛一直往这儿跑？

lines.en: : You do realize I'm a teacher right? Being at school is kind of my job.
lines.zh: : 你该知道我是老师吧？待在学校本来就是我的工作。

lines.en: : Mhm! But have you ever seen any other teachers around here over the weekend?
lines.zh: : 嗯哼！可你周末在这附近见过别的老师吗？

lines.en: : Actually...no. I haven’t.
lines.zh: : 说起来……没有。还真没见过。

lines.en: : Yeah, that's what I thought! Take a friggin' day off sometime, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 对吧，我就说！偶尔也他妈休息一天啊，老师！

lines.en: Huh...I can't tell if it's weird that I've yet to bump into any other teachers around here yet.
lines.zh: 嗯……我到现在都没在这附近撞见过任何别的老师，这算不算奇怪，我也说不好。

lines.en: I've obviously seen some other staff members around, but...none on the weekend.
lines.zh: 我当然见过一些别的教职员工，但……周末一个都没有。

lines.en: Which...I guess makes sense if there aren’t any other clubs with weekend practice.
lines.zh: 这样……如果没有别的社团在周末训练，倒也说得通。

lines.en: scene nightvisionredux6
: All jokin' aside, we kinda need you, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 玩笑归玩笑，我们还挺需要你的，老师！

lines.en: : The other teachers don’t really care about our team now that the normal coach is havin’ her baby and stuff.
lines.zh: : 原来的教练在生孩子什么的，别的老师就完全不管我们这支队伍了。

lines.en: : I've heard from some of the other girls that they're calling our club pointless without any real opponents.
lines.zh: : 我听别的女生说，他们说我们没有真正的对手，这个社团毫无意义。

lines.en: : I mean...isn't it?
lines.zh: : 我是说……难道不是吗？

lines.en: : Heck no! That ain't it at all! We're all here for one reason and one reason only! To be a part of a team and to have fun playin' soccer.
lines.zh: : 才不是！根本不是那么回事！我们所有人在这里只有一个理由！为了成为团队的一员，为了开心地踢球。

lines.en: : That would be two-
lines.zh: : 那是两个理由——

lines.en: : Bein’ part of a team means hangin’ out and practicin’ every day...and helpin’ each other through tough times!
lines.zh: : 成为团队的一员，就是每天一起玩、一起训练……还要在困难的时候互相扶持！

lines.en: : We're like a big family over here!
lines.zh: : 我们这儿就像一个大家庭！

lines.en: A family, huh? I guess I can see that.
lines.zh: 家人啊？我好像能理解。

lines.en: That reminds me, I don’t really know anything about Miku’s family yet.
lines.zh: 说起来，我对 Miku 的家人还一无所知。

lines.en: I wonder what they’re like?
lines.zh: 不知道他们是什么样的人？

lines.en: : Hey Miku, I was wondering-
lines.zh: : 嘿 Miku，我想问问——

lines.en: scene nightvisionredux7
: GUH! Can't we invest in a...quieter whistle or something?
lines.zh: : 呃啊！咱就不能买个……安静点的哨子什么的吗？

lines.en: : Miku! We still need those extra cones for our drills! Can you get them or should I just send Kirin instead?!
lines.zh: : Miku！训练还缺那些额外的锥桶呢！你去拿，还是我干脆派 Kirin 去？！

lines.en: : Oh, good. A chance to find out if Kirin is actually a six foot male.
lines.zh: : 哦，好啊。正好有机会确认一下 Kirin 是不是真是个六英尺高的男人。

lines.en: : Shoot. I totally forgot I was supposed to be doin’ stuff.
lines.zh: : 靠。我完全忘了自己还有活儿要干。

lines.en: : Aren’t you the captain? Why’s that tall girl bossing you around like that?
lines.zh: : 你不是队长吗？怎么被那个高个子女生这么使唤？

lines.en: : I’ll get em in one sec! Sorry about that!
lines.zh: : 我马上就去拿！不好意思啊！

lines.en: scene nightvisionredux6
: That tall girl is Karin Kanda. She’s the vice-captain of the team and ain't really tryin' to boss me around.
lines.zh: : 那个高个子是 Karin Kanda。她是队里的副队长，其实也不是真想使唤我。

lines.en: : She’s been wantin’ to try more of that ‘bein’ in charge stuff’ lately, so I figured I’d let her take the reins today.
lines.zh: : 她最近一直想多试试「掌权」那套，所以我想今天就让她来掌舵吧。

lines.en: scene nightvisionredux1
: Oh! Here's an idea! Wanna help me carry all the cones out so we can get back to talkin' faster?
lines.zh: : 哦！有了！你要不要帮我一起把锥桶搬出去，这样我们就能快点回来接着聊？

lines.en: : Your arms are a lot bigger than mine so we can probably do it all in one trip with the two of us!
lines.zh: : 你的胳膊比我粗多了，咱俩一起估计一趟就搞定！

lines.en: : Sure. I don't see any problem following a teenage girl into a dark storage room with tons of other girls watching.
lines.zh: : 好啊。跟着一个十几岁的女孩走进漆黑的储藏室，还有一大群女生看着，我看不出有什么问题。

lines.en: scene nightvisionredux6
: Problems? Whatcha mean?
lines.zh: : 问题？你指什么？

lines.en: : Nothing at all, Miku. Just lead the way.
lines.zh: : 没什么，Miku。你带路吧。

lines.en: scene black
Miku starts sprinting over to a storage room attached to what I believe is the school gym and I am forced to jog just to keep up with her.
lines.zh: Miku 朝一间连着——我猜是学校体育馆——的储藏室冲刺过去，我被迫小跑才能跟上。

lines.en: I think about looking behind me to see if anyone is watching but, after realizing that might make me look even {i}more{/i} suspicious, I elect to keep my head down instead...
lines.zh: 我想回头看看有没有人在看，但转念一想那样反而显得{i}更{/i}可疑，于是决定低着头继续走……

lines.en: scene painisreal1
: So! Here we are! Home sweet home!
lines.zh: : 好啦！到啦！甜蜜的家！

lines.en: : Would you mind explaining to me why we just stepped over a mattress?
lines.zh: : 你能解释一下，我们刚才为什么跨过了一张床垫吗？

lines.en: : Doesn't every storage room need a mattress?
lines.zh: : 储藏室不都该有张床垫吗？
: ……不是吧？

lines.en: : I obviously know that, Sensei. The mattress is just a thing Kirin set up so she could slack off during practice.
lines.zh: : 我当然知道啦，老师。那张床垫就是 Kirin 弄来的，好让她训练的时候能偷懒。

lines.en: : Pretty sure she dragged it here by herself and none of us wanna get rid of it, so...I guess we've just got a mattress now?
lines.zh: : 我猜是她自己拖过来的，我们谁也懒得扔，所以……现在算是有了张床垫吧？

lines.en: : Kinda works out, though, since the storage room doubles as our medical tent thingy for now.
lines.zh: : 不过也算歪打正着，因为这储藏室现在还兼当我们的医疗帐篷。

lines.en: : Isn’t the actual nurse’s office connected to the soccer field?
lines.zh: : 真正的保健室不是连着足球场吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, but she doesn’t come in on weekends.
lines.zh: : 是啊，可她周末不上班。

lines.en: : Huh...
scene painisreal2
: You got some kinda problem with mattresses, Sensei? Yer actin' all weird all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : 老师你对床垫有意见吗？怎么突然怪怪的。

lines.en: : Nope. If anything, I'm glad to have such a convenient mattress stashed away in such a discreet location.
lines.zh: : 没有。要说的话，我还挺高兴有这么一张方便的床垫藏在这么隐蔽的地方。

lines.en: : For what? You gonna sneak in here to take naps during school or something?
lines.zh: : 干嘛用？你打算上课时间溜进来睡午觉啥的？

lines.en: : Close. I'm sure you’ll find out eventually.
lines.zh: : 接近了。你早晚会知道的。

lines.en: scene painisreal3
: Well, Idunno what the heck you’re talkin’ about, but I’m gonna start grabbin’ some cones.
lines.zh: : 好吧，我不知道你在说啥，不过我要开始搬锥桶了。

lines.en: : If we’re in here for too long, the girls might get the wrong idea or somethin’.
lines.zh: : 我们在里面待太久，她们可能会想歪什么的。

lines.en: scene painisreal1
: You start grabbin’ all the ones in the corner near the door and I’ll get the ones over here in the back, got it?
lines.zh: : 你负责拿门边角落那堆，后面的我来，明白吗？

lines.en: : Got it.
lines.zh: : 明白。

lines.en: scene painisreal4
I turn around and begin searching my side of the room for any cones we might be able to use for the girls’ drills.
lines.zh: 我转过身，开始在我这半边房间里翻找能拿来给女生们训练的锥桶。

lines.en: I can make out one tucked away behind a-
lines.zh: 我隐约看见一个塞在什么后面——

lines.en: : Jesus...what the fuck was that?
lines.zh: : 靠……那他妈是什么？

lines.en: : Sorry, sorry! Rogue soccer ball! Everything's okay!
lines.zh: : 抱歉抱歉！是不听话的足球！没事了！

lines.en: I can hear a set of footsteps outside of the door as one of the girls comes over to retrieve the apparently {i}rogue{/i} soccer ball.
lines.zh: 门外传来一串脚步声，一个女生过来捡那只显然{i}不听话{/i}的足球。

lines.en: I guess someone must have kicked it a little too hard or...too far or something and it wound up bouncing off of the door.
lines.zh: 我猜是谁踢得太用力、或者踢得太远什么的，球最后弹到了门上。

lines.en: : Shouldn't they be playing a little more...I don't know, carefully?
lines.zh: : 她们就不能踢得……那个，小心点吗？

lines.en: : You guys might wind up breaking something at this rate.
lines.zh: : 照这个势头下去，你们迟早要砸坏什么东西。

lines.en: : Miku?
lines.zh: : Miku？

lines.zh: : {b}AAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!!!!!{/i}

lines.en: I’m frozen in place as I watch Miku begin to claw at her scalp with her fingernails.
lines.zh: 我僵在原地，看着 Miku 开始用指甲抓挠自己的头皮。

lines.en: : {i}Ahhhh.....hah...hah......AHHHHH!!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Ahhhh.....hah...hah......AHHHHH!!{/i}

lines.en: She won’t stop screaming.
lines.zh: 她停不下来地尖叫。

lines.en: scene happy1
scene happy2
scene happy9
scene painisreal8
: Miku...what’s going-
lines.zh: : Miku……怎么回——

lines.en: scene help5
scene painisreal9
: {b}DON’T COME NEAR ME!{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}别过来！{/b}

lines.en: scene happy1
scene happy2
scene happy9
scene painisreal10
A world without light, where nightvision plays messiah.
lines.zh: 一个没有光的世界，在那里夜视扮演救世主。

lines.en: Where good little boys and good little girls are gifted with forgiveness.
lines.zh: 在那里，乖乖的小男孩和乖乖的小女孩被赐予宽恕。

lines.en: Come with me!
lines.zh: 跟我来！

lines.en: To a better place!
lines.zh: 去一个更好的地方！

lines.en: Let us {s}GET AWAY{/s} escape this hell together!
lines.zh: 让我们{s}逃离{/s}一起逃离这个地狱！

lines.en: Do your eyes play tricks on you?
lines.zh: 你的眼睛在欺骗你吗？

lines.en: If so, close them!
lines.zh: 如果是，就闭上！

lines.en: Relinquish yourself to me and the two of us can spend our lives together!
lines.zh: 把自己交给我，我们两个就能共度一生！

lines.en: Time matters not!
lines.zh: 时间无关紧要！

lines.en: Fear matters not!
lines.zh: 恐惧无关紧要！

lines.en: All that matters is us!
lines.zh: 唯一重要的只有我们！

lines.en: scene painisreal11
Pain is real!
lines.zh: 痛苦是真的！

lines.en: Happiness is real!
lines.zh: 幸福是真的！

lines.en: Everything is real!
lines.zh: 一切都是真的！

lines.en: A whole new world awaits us!
lines.zh: 一个全新的世界在等着我们！

lines.en: 信じて！
lines.zh: 信じて！ (相信我！)

lines.en: 信じて！
lines.zh: 信じて！ (相信我！)

lines.en: 信じて！
lines.zh: 信じて！ (相信我！)

lines.en: 信じて！信じて！信じて！信じて！信じて！信じて！信じて！信じて！信じて！信じて！信じて！信じて！信じて！
lines.zh: 信じて！信じて！信じて！信じて！信じて！信じて！信じて！信じて！信じて！信じて！信じて！信じて！信じて！ (相信我！)

lines.en: scene help5
scene painisreal8
: What’s going on in here?!
lines.zh: : 这里面发生什么了？！

lines.en: Two girls from the team run into the storage room and surround Miku.
lines.zh: 队里的两个女生冲进储藏室，围住了 Miku。

lines.en: scene painnew1
: {b}NO! GET AWAY FROM ME! LEAVE ME ALONE! GET AWAY GET AWAY GET AWAY!{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}不！离我远点！别管我！滚开滚开滚开！{/b}

lines.en: : Oh my god...but...how?...
lines.zh: : 天哪……可是……怎么会？……

lines.en: : What happened?
lines.zh: : 发生了什么？

lines.en: : I...I kicked a ball and...and it hit the door...The noise must have-
lines.zh: : 我……我踢了一脚球，然后……然后它撞到了门上……那声音一定——

lines.en: : Miku. Miku, it's me. Karin. Everything is okay. You're fine.
lines.zh: : Miku。Miku，是我，Karin。一切都好。你没事的。

lines.en: scene painnew2
: We...we were just playing...I didn’t mean to-
lines.zh: : 我们……我们只是在玩……我不是故意的——

lines.en: : Kirin, let me handle this.
lines.zh: : Kirin，让我来处理。

lines.en: : Miku, listen to me. You're safe. We're here for you.
lines.zh: : Miku，听我说。你安全了。我们都在这儿陪着你。

lines.en: : {i}Hah...hah...hah...hahhh...ahhhhh...{/i}
: Good girl...Just like that...Deep breaths...In and out...In and out...
lines.zh: : 好孩子……就这样……深呼吸……吸气，呼气……吸气，呼气……

lines.en: The girl to my left begins to coach Miku through some breathing exercises as I stand here absolutely useless.
lines.zh: 我左边那个女生开始带着 Miku 做呼吸练习，而我站在那儿，完全帮不上忙。

lines.en: What...could have caused this?
lines.zh: 到底是什么……引发了这种事？

lines.en: What happened to her?
lines.zh: 她到底经历过什么？

lines.en: scene painnew3
: Sensei...I’m sorry, but could you please leave us alone for now?
lines.zh: : 老师……抱歉，能不能请你先回避一下？

lines.en: : She’ll be okay.
lines.zh: : 她会没事的。

lines.en: : She’s just a little scared, that’s all.
lines.zh: : 她只是有点害怕，就这样。

lines.en: : Oh, uhh...yeah.
: I’ll go.
lines.zh: : 我这就走。

lines.en: : Are you sure you’ve got this under control?
lines.zh: : 你确定能搞定吗？

lines.en: : I am. It's not the first time something like this has happened.
lines.zh: : 确定。这种事不是第一次发生了。

lines.en: : Kirin will come with you. It would be best if I did this alone.
lines.zh: : Kirin 会跟你一起出去。我一个人来比较好。

lines.en: : But I...I can...
lines.zh: : 可我……我可以……

lines.en: scene painnew4
: Okay...
lines.zh: : 好吧……

lines.en: : I really didn’t mean to-
lines.zh: : 我真的不是故意的——

lines.en: : Just go. We’ll talk about it later.
lines.zh: : 走吧。这件事我们回头再说。

lines.en: scene black
I exit the storage room alongside Kirin, enveloping myself in the sounds of urgent consolation bleeding through the large metal doors.
lines.zh: 我和 Kirin 一起走出储藏室，那扇大铁门里渗出的急切安抚声将我包围。

lines.en: Something is wrong.
lines.zh: 有什么不对劲。

lines.en: Something is very wrong.
lines.zh: 有什么非常不对劲。

lines.en: scene ohno
{i}Oh no! It looks like Miku may have ripped out some of her hair!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}不好了！Miku 好像把自己的头发扯下来了一些！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Will you still think she’s pretty when it's all gone?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}等头发全掉光了，你还会觉得她漂亮吗？{/i}

$ miku_love += 1
{i}Miku’s affection has increased to [miku_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Miku 的好感度提升到了 [miku_love]!{/i}
